dashboard.mcpWorkflowSteps:
1. list_protocols with organization_id (required on every call; users belong to multiple orgs)
2. upload_protocol_file (optional Protocol Challenge context files)
3. generate_protocol_unsys_seed (optional Unsys model)
4. create_protocol: organization_id plus one Author source — challenge (The Protocol Challenge; optional exact_problem_on_canvas), artifacts (challenge generated when a learner opens), or opening_canvas_scene — plus answers_model_seed, enforced_channels, duration_minutes. Do not send kind.
5. get_protocol
6. update_protocol
7. delete_protocol when a protocol should be removed
8. get_knowledge_region_options → create_knowledge_region → get_knowledge_region (optional AI-use and strategy simulation)
dashboard.mcpDualNote: REST and MCP stay in parity for protocol management under /api/v3/protocols and knowledge regions under /api/v3/knowledge-regions.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introBody: Uncertain Systems ("Uncertain Systems", "we", "us", or "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use Uncertain Systems and our services.
privacy.personalInfoIntro: We may collect personal information that you voluntarily provide to us when you:
privacy.personalInfoTypes: This information may include: email address, username, audio recordings during blocks, EEG brainwave data, uploaded transcripts, and block metadata.
privacy.autoCollectedBody: When you visit our website, we automatically collect certain information about your device, including browser type, IP address, and time zone. We do not use analytics or advertising trackers.
privacy.howWeUseIntro: We use the information we collect to:
privacy.howWeUseItem1: Provide the tutoring experience (audio analysis, probe generation, reports)
privacy.howWeUseItem2: Store and replay your block history
privacy.howWeUseItem3: Personalize probes using your uploaded think-aloud transcripts
privacy.howWeUseItem4: Record and summarize EEG data during blocks
privacy.howWeUseItem6: Respond to your inquiries and support requests
privacy.howWeUseItem7: Improve our platform and AI tutoring quality
privacy.thirdPartyIntro: We share data with the following third-party services, strictly to operate Uncertain Systems:
privacy.thirdPartySupabase: authentication, database, and file storage (audio, EEG, transcripts)
privacy.thirdPartyXai: AI model inference, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, image generation, and file storage for probes, plans, reports, and block artifacts
privacy.thirdPartyStripe: payment processing (we never see or store your card details)
privacy.noSellData: We do not sell your personal information to third parties.
privacy.dataSecurityBody: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal information. Audio recordings and EEG data are stored in private, per-user storage buckets. However, no electronic transmission over the Internet or information storage technology can be guaranteed to be 100% secure.
privacy.gdprIntro: If you are a resident of the European Economic Area (EEA), you have certain data protection rights:
privacy.gdprAccessDesc: Request access to your personal data
privacy.gdprErasureDesc: Request deletion of your personal data
privacy.gdprObjectionDesc: Object to processing of your data
privacy.gdprContact: To exercise these rights, please contact us at daniel@uncertain.systems.
privacy.anonymizedDataIntro: With your explicit consent, we collect anonymized think-aloud data from tutoring blocks to build AI training, fine-tuning, and context engineering datasets. This data is used to improve the quality of tutoring and advance research in AI-assisted education.
privacy.whatWeCollectIntro: Depending on your preferences (configurable in your Dashboard), this may include:
privacy.transcriptsOnlyDesc: Anonymized text transcripts of your think-aloud blocks, including reasoning patterns and probe interactions
privacy.transcriptsAudioDesc: In addition to transcripts, anonymized audio recordings that capture speech patterns (pauses, hesitation, tone shifts) — voice fingerprints are never stored or included
privacy.anonymizeItem1: All names, emails, and personally identifiable information are removed
privacy.anonymizeItem2: Block metadata (timestamps, user IDs) is stripped or cryptographically hashed
privacy.anonymizeItem3: Data cannot be traced back to individual users
privacy.yourControlBody: Data sharing is opt-in and disabled by default. You can change your preferences at any time from the "Data & Privacy" tab in your Dashboard. Changes apply to future blocks only — previously shared data remains in existing datasets. You may request removal of all your contributed data by contacting us.
privacy.dataRetentionBody: We retain your personal information only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected. You can delete any block from your dashboard at any time — all associated data (audio, EEG, probes, reports) is permanently removed. Account deletion can be requested via email.
privacy.childrenBody: Our services are not directed to children under 16. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe we have collected information from a child, please contact us immediately.
privacy.changesBody: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page with an updated revision date.
privacy.contactIntro: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:

step1.title: Generate Work in turns
step1.imageAlt: Open a chapter and do work
step1.body: Open a chapter to start a turn. Speak, write, and draw on the Work canvas — that is your Work. A timer is running: when it hits zero the canvas clears.

step2.title: Work on the canvas
step2.body: Speak, write, and draw on the work canvas. Use Commands on a selection.
step2.bodyProject: Speak, write, and draw on the work canvas. Use Commands on a selection.

step3.title: Then move on
step3.body: You work on each chapter's canvas. Switch chapters from the dock.
step3.bodyProject: You work on each chapter's canvas. Switch chapters from the dock.

step1.title: What you'll do
step1.body:
Your job is to think out loud for the whole timed session — including while you read each question. Speak as you reason.

When you finish a chain of thought, press I'm done answering to close your turn. Stay speaking: five seconds of silence auto-stashes your words, and too much silence invalidates the session.

When the timer ends, your proof of work is saved.
step1.highlight: Thinking out loud also means reading the question out loud. Imagine you’re explaining this to someone — or recording a live stream — so you keep talking through the whole turn.

step2.title: How the interface works
step2.body:
Speak — your words appear in the live bar at the bottom.

• Del — stash for later
• Thought Memory — edit or delete individual thoughts while you keep speaking
• I'm done answering — close your turn (you can still edit or delete first)

Stay speaking. After 5 seconds of silence, thoughts auto-stash. At zero purity, the session is invalidated.

step3.title: Pick your starting focus
step3.body: Choose a starting angle. The timer begins with that topic’s question.
step3.quoteText: The expert in anything was once a beginner who refused to give up.

step1.title: Tap what you would not trust
step1.body: Tap every question you would not trust yourself to answer. The screens get finer or stop on their own.

step3.title: Tap what you would not trust
step3.body:
Read the opening lines out loud to start. Then tap every question you would not trust yourself to answer. The screens get finer or stop on their own. No speaking is required after the opening.

Those taps are saved for later Learn sessions.

welcome.panelIntro:
Welcome to Verify. Work the question before the clock ends. Speak, write, and draw as you go.

How it works: speak out loud — your transcription accumulates in the bar. Stash thoughts as you go, then press I'm done answering to close your turn. I respond under my avatar with one question at a time. Thought Memory keeps every trace for resend or bookmarking.

Session length and conversation language are on the right. When time runs out, you'll return to the workspace — open the Performance tab when you're ready for unified scoring.
welcome.callToAction: When you're ready, press Start. The timer starts, and I'll open with a specific question about what you learned here.
